prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Verify Your Desktop Render", "Confirm that your companion is visible on your screen before finishing setup.", "Pet Is Visible"]
1: ["Select Your Adoption Path", "Pick a ready-to-go companion preset or generate a custom pet from photos.", "Creation Options"]
2: ["Choose & Customize Companion", "Select your starter desktop pet and customize initial style settings.", "Styles & Colors"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Interact directly on your screen or use system tray quick options to control your companion."]
4: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a system notification as soon as your pet is ready.", "Desktop Alert Active"]
5: ["Check lighting and face angle for optimal custom companion rendering.", "Photo Quality Checklist"]
6: ["Sign In to Restore Your Companions", "Signing in syncs your existing desktop pets and restores saved accessories safely.", "Pet Sync Guaranteed"]
7: ["Meet Your Screen Companion", "Desktop pets roam your monitor, react to clicks, and keep you company while you work.", "Continue to Path Selection"]
8: ["Official Adoption Seal", "Your pet adoption certificate is confirmed and ready for final desktop setup.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Right-click the desktop pet or taskbar tray icon anytime to manage visibility and settings.", "Desktop Control Hints"]
